title: LatentSift: Policy-State Filtering for Token-Efficient Verification of Software Engineering Agents
title_zh: LatentSift: 策略状态筛选用于软件工程代理的 token-高效验证

paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling improves software engineering agents by generating multiple candidate trajectories and selecting the best one. Verifying and selecting among these long interactions can consume as many tokens as generation itself. Existing hybrid workflows first apply an LLM-based execution-free (EF) verifier to filter candidates before running tests, which adds another model pass over every trajectory. We introduce LatentSift, a token-free and execution-free filter that replaces this first stage with hidden states the policy already produces while generating the candidates. It represents each candidate through its reasoning, observation, and function-call states, compares them with positive and negative banks of such states collected from successful and unsuccessful trajectories during policy training, and fuses the resulting distance scores with a learned linear score to retain promising candidates for the execution-based stages. On SWE-bench Verified, across three agents and two policy sizes, LatentSift cuts EF-verifier tokens by 66.6–81.0% and total verification tokens, which include test generation, by 49.1–62.1% at K = 16 K=16 , while hybrid Best@16 matches or improves on each agent’s reference workflow, rising from 59.26% to 60.06% on DeepSWE-Preview.

paragraphs.en: Efforts to improve LLM reasoning in academia and industry follow two broad directions: training more capable models to solve harder problems, and allocating more computation to each problem at inference time. Training can strengthen the model’s reasoning ability before deployment ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . The latter approach, known as test-time scaling, seeks better answers by allowing longer reasoning, generating multiple candidates, or searching with verifier feedback ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Aggarwal et al., 2023 ; Snell et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Rather than relying on a single attempt, these methods spend additional inference compute exploring and selecting solutions of the problem.

paragraphs.en: For software engineering (SWE) tasks, recent open agents use a hybrid verification workflow to select among generated trajectories ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ) . Figure 1 shows its four stages: an execution-free (EF) verifier scores all candidates and retains half; instance-supplied tests provide regression signals; LLM-generated tests provide additional execution signals; and the EF scores derived from Stage 1 determine the final choice among survivors. The Stage 1 EF verifier is typically a separately fine-tuned LLM that reads the trajectories produced by the policy ( Shum et al., 2026 ) . Execution-free does not mean token-free: each candidate is processed by the verifier model again, adding verifier input and output tokens. This cost is particularly high on SWE tasks, where a trajectory commonly contains tens of thousands of tokens from reasoning, repository exploration, tool feedback, and code edits. Reprocessing such trajectories adds substantial token consumption to already expensive long-context inference ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) . For a recent open policy such as DeepSWE-Preview with K = 16 K=16 candidates, Stage 1 alone consumes approximately 850K tokens per task instance and the full verification workflow approximately 1,050K, exceeding the approximately 850K tokens used to generate the candidates. Candidate verification can thus rival generation as a source of inference-time token cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在软件工程（SWE）任务中，近期的开放智能体采用混合验证工作流程，从生成的轨迹中进行选择（Luo 等，2025；Jain 等，2025）。 图 1 展示了其四个阶段：无需执行的（EF）验证器为所有候选项打分并保留其中一半；实例提供的测试提供回归信号；大型语言模型（LLM）生成的测试提供额外的执行信号；而第一阶段得出的 EF 分数则决定在剩余候选项中的最终选择。 第一阶段的 EF 验证器通常是一个单独微调的大型语言模型，用于读取策略生成的轨迹（Shum 等，2026）。 无需执行并不意味着无需令牌：每个候选项都需要由验证器模型再次处理，从而增加验证器的输入和输出令牌数量。 在软件工程任务中，这种成本尤其高昂，因为一条轨迹通常包含数万个来自推理、仓库探索、工具反馈和代码编辑的令牌。 重新处理此类轨迹会显著增加本已昂贵的长上下文推理所需的令牌消耗（Kim 等，2026；Kwon 等，2023；Xie 等，2025）。 以 DeepSWE-Preview 这样的近期开放策略为例，当候选项数量 K = 16 时，仅第一阶段每任务实例就消耗约 85 万个令牌，而整个验证工作流程则消耗约 105 万个令牌，超过了生成这些候选项所消耗的约 85 万个令牌。 因此，候选项验证可能成为与生成过程相当的主要推理时令牌消耗来源。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a token-efficient verification method called LatentSift . It filters candidate trajectories using hidden states collected during the generating process, introducing no additional LLM token cost and requiring no test execution. We represent each trajectory through three channels: reasoning, environment observations, and function calls. For each channel, we compare candidate states with positive and negative banks collected during policy training, aggregate the step-level distance margins, and rank candidates for the task instance. We take the minimum of the three channel ranks as the distance score, so a candidate scores highly only if it ranks highly in every channel. We also train a linear scorer on policy hidden states to assign each candidate a learned trajectory score. We rank these scores within each task instance, normalize the ranks, and average them with the candidates’ distance-based scores to obtain the final filtering scores. This learned signal forms part of the filter. We use LatentSift to replace the highly token-costing Stage 1 of the hybrid workflow, retaining half the candidates so execution-based stages and the final LLM verifier operate on a smaller pool, significantly reducing the token cost of the verification workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种名为 LatentSift 的令牌高效验证方法。 该方法利用生成过程中收集的隐藏状态来筛选候选轨迹，既不会增加额外的 LLM 令牌成本，也无需执行测试。 我们通过三个通道来表示每条轨迹：推理、环境观察和函数调用。 对于每个通道，我们将候选状态与策略训练期间收集的正样本库和负样本库进行比较，汇总各步骤的距离余量，并对该任务实例的候选状态进行排序。 我们取三个通道排名中的最小值作为距离分数，因此只有当候选状态在所有通道中均排名靠前时，才能获得高分。 我们还基于策略隐藏状态训练一个线性评分器，为每个候选状态分配一个经过学习的轨迹分数。 我们在每个任务实例内部对这些分数进行排序，对排名进行归一化处理，并将其与候选状态的基于距离的分数取平均，从而得到最终的筛选分数。 这种经过学习的信号构成了筛选器的一部分。 我们使用 LatentSift 来替代混合工作流程中令牌成本极高的第一阶段，保留一半的候选状态，使得基于执行阶段的步骤和最终的 LLM 验证器能够处理更小的候选池，从而显著降低验证流程的令牌成本。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (i) We introduce LatentSift, a token-free, execution-free filtering mechanism for long-horizon software engineering agents, and integrate it into an inference-time hybrid verification workflow. (ii) We design a three-channel trajectory representation that separately pools reasoning, observation, and function-call states already computed by the generating policy. We then develop a trajectory scoring method, which combines contrastive distances to successful and unsuccessful experience across the three channels through minimum-rank fusion, then integrates a learned trajectory score to rank candidates within each task instance. (iii) We evaluate LatentSift across multiple software engineering agents and policies on SWE-bench Verified, demonstrating substantial verification-token savings while maintaining competitive selection quality. On DeepSWE-Preview, it reduces total verification tokens by 62.1% while improving hybrid Best@16.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 (i) 我们提出了 LatentSift，一种无需令牌、无需执行的过滤机制，适用于长期规划的软件工程智能体，并将其整合到推理阶段的混合验证工作流程中。 (ii) 我们设计了一种三通道轨迹表示方法，分别对生成策略已计算的推理、观察和函数调用状态进行池化。 接着，我们开发了一种轨迹评分方法：通过最小秩融合将成功与失败经验在三通道上的对比距离相结合，再整合一个学习到的轨迹分数，以在每次任务实例中对候选方案进行排序。 (iii) 我们在 SWE-bench Verified 数据集上，针对多种软件工程智能体与策略评估了 LatentSift，结果表明该方法在保持具有竞争力的选择质量的同时，显著减少了验证令牌的使用量。 在 DeepSWE-Preview 上，该方法将总验证令牌数量减少了 62.1%，同时提升了混合 Best@16 指标。

paragraphs.en: Test-time compute can be spent on repeated sampling, adaptive stopping, parallel probing, search, and verifier-guided selection ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Aggarwal et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ; Snell et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) ; on learned allocation and multi-agent pipelines ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026b ; Motwani et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; or on interaction, revision, and search, as in ReAct, Reflexion, Tree of Thoughts, and language-agent tree search ( Yao et al., 2023b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023a ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . For SWE-bench, CodeMonkeys separates candidate coverage from selection and pays for selection with generated tests and a model-based selector ( Ehrlich et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Outcome verifiers and process supervision were developed for mathematical reasoning ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Uesato et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2023 ) and extended to Q-value ranking, practical process-reward design, and step-wise promise or progress for agents ( Li and Li, 2025 ; Choudhury, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Xi et al., 2026 ) . Preference optimization offers a related route to comparative judgments ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , and RewardBench, reward-overoptimization scaling laws, and LLM-as-a-judge studies document the robustness limits of learned evaluators ( Lambert et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Our verifier pairs a non-parametric distance judgment with a lightweight learned score, both computed from cached policy states.
paragraphs.zh: 成果验证器和流程监督最初是为数学推理而开发的（Cobbe 等，2021；Lightman 等，2024；Uesato 等，2022；Wang 等，2024；Ma 等，2023），随后被扩展至 Q 值排序、实用的流程奖励设计，以及智能体的分步承诺或进展（Li 和 Li，2025；Choudhury，2025；Zhang 等，2025b；Xi 等，2026）。 偏好优化为比较性判断提供了相关路径（Rafailov 等，2023），而 RewardBench、奖励过度优化缩放定律以及“LLM 作为裁判”的研究则揭示了学习型评估器的稳健性极限（Lambert 等，2025；Gao 等，2023；Zheng 等，2023）。 我们的验证器将一种非参数距离判断与一个轻量级的学习得分相结合，两者均基于缓存的策略状态进行计算。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates LatentSift, which serves as the first-stage candidate filter in the hybrid verification workflow shown in Figure 1 . It replaces the initial LLM-based EF verifier and retains half the candidates for the subsequent regression tests, LLM-generated tests, and final LLM-based EF verification. During policy training, we collect reasoning, observation, and function-call states from trajectories with known outcomes and store them together in positive and negative banks. During inference, we collect candidate states as the policy generates each trajectory. The distance branch compares these states with successful and unsuccessful experience in the banks, aggregates the evidence over steps, and combines the three channel ranks into a distance score. A trained linear scorer provides a learned trajectory score for each candidate. We rank the learned scores within the task instance and average the normalized ranks with the distance scores to obtain the final filtering scores. The filter retains half the candidates without additional LLM tokens or test execution. The subsequent EB stages and final LLM verifier operate on the retained pool. The following sections describe state extraction, bank construction, distance scoring, and fusion with the learned signal.
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了LatentSift，它在图1所示的混合验证工作流程中用作第一阶段的候选筛选器。 它取代了最初的基于LLM的EF验证器，并为后续的回归测试、LLM生成的测试以及最终的基于LLM的EF验证保留一半的候选项。 在策略训练期间，我们从结果已知的轨迹中收集推理、观察和函数调用状态，并将它们分别存储在正样本库和负样本库中。 在推理阶段，当策略生成每条轨迹时，我们会收集候选状态。 距离分支将这些状态与样本库中的成功和失败经验进行比较，对各步骤的证据进行汇总，并将三个通道的排名组合成一个距离分数。 一个训练好的线性评分器为每个候选项提供一个经过学习的轨迹分数。 我们在任务实例内对这些学习到的分数进行排序，并将归一化后的排名与距离分数取平均，以获得最终的筛选分数。 该筛选器无需额外的LLM令牌或测试执行即可保留一半的候选项。 后续的EB阶段和最终的LLM验证器将基于保留下来的候选池运行。 以下各节将描述状态提取、样本库构建、距离评分以及与学习信号的融合过程。

sents.en: We rank the learned scores within the task instance and average the normalized ranks with the distance scores to obtain the final filtering scores.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on the 500 human-validated GitHub issues in SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . For each task instance, an agent generates multiple trajectories, each ending in a candidate repository patch. The verification workflow evaluates these candidates and selects one patch. We determine whether the selected patch resolves the instance using the official evaluation. All verification methods use the same candidate pool within each agent-policy configuration, so differences in performance reflect candidate verification rather than generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-bench Verified 中由人类验证的 500 个 GitHub 问题上进行评估（Jimenez 等人，2024）。 对于每个任务实例，一个智能体会生成多条轨迹，每条轨迹最终都会产生一个候选仓库补丁。 验证流程会评估这些候选项，并选择一个补丁。 我们通过官方评估方法判断所选补丁是否解决了该实例。 在所有验证方法中，每个智能体策略配置都使用相同的候选池，因此性能差异反映的是候选项的验证效果，而非生成效果。

paragraphs.en: We also conduct evaluation on various policy models. DeepSWE-Preview is RL-trained from Qwen3-32B ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , R2EGym-32B is fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , and CWM is a 32B open-weights model ( FAIR CodeGen Team et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: For each policy–agent configuration, we generate 16 trajectories for each of the 500 task instances, yielding 8,000 trajectories per configuration. Verifier comparisons use the same pool. Changing the agent scaffold requires generating new trajectories and running the tests on their patches again. Following prior hybrid workflows ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ) , the R2E-TestgenAgent ( R2E-Gym, 2025a ) was employed to generate one set of tests per task instance. For each agent, we build positive and negative banks from trajectories and their three-channel hidden states collected during generator model training, containing 1,383 successful and 1,383 unsuccessful trajectories from repositories disjoint from the evaluation repositories. For each K K , we report mean Best@ K K over 200 draws of K K candidates from each fixed pool, using stored test results.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种策略–智能体配置，我们为 500 个任务实例中的每个实例生成 16 条轨迹，因此每种配置共产生 8,000 条轨迹。 验证器比较使用相同的池。 更改智能体框架需要生成新的轨迹，并再次对其补丁运行测试。 遵循先前的混合工作流程（Luo 等人，2025；Jain 等人，2025），我们使用了 R2E-TestgenAgent（R2E-Gym，2025a）为每个任务实例生成一组测试。 对于每个智能体，我们从生成器模型训练期间收集的轨迹及其三通道隐藏状态中构建正例和负例库，这些库包含来自与评估库分离的存储库中的 1,383 条成功轨迹和 1,383 条失败轨迹。 对于每个 K K，我们基于从每个固定池中抽取的 200 个 K K 候选者，利用已存储的测试结果报告平均 Best@ K K。

paragraphs.en: Our primary quality metric is Best@ K K , the percentage of task instances solved by the candidate selected from a pool of size K K ; hybrid Best@ K K is this rate after the complete four-stage cascade. Oracle Pass@ K K reports the corresponding candidate-generation ceiling by assuming that the best candidate will always be selected. We measure verification token cost by reporting EF-verifier tokens and total verification tokens including test generation. EF-verifier token counts use the calls made by each workflow, reusing Stage 1 scores in Stage 4 when available. We charge the logged test-generation cost to a workflow only if it reaches Stage 3.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要质量指标是 Best@K K，即从大小为 K K 的候选池中选择出的候选智能体所解决的任务实例的百分比；混合 Best@K K 则是完成全部四个阶段级联流程后的这一比率。 Oracle Pass@K K 通过假设最佳候选智能体总能被选中，来报告相应的候选生成上限。 我们通过报告 EF-verifier 令牌数和包含测试生成的总验证令牌数来衡量验证令牌成本。 EF-verifier 令牌计数使用每个工作流所发起的调用，并在可用时于阶段 4 重复使用阶段 1 的分数。 只有当工作流到达阶段 3 时，我们才会将其记录的测试生成成本计入该工作流。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows that LatentSift substantially reduces verification tokens on both R2EGym policies while maintaining hybrid resolution rates. At K = 16 K=16 , EF-verifier tokens fall from 366K to 76K per task instance on R2EGym-32B and from 344K to 65K on R2EGym-14B. Including test generation, total verification cost falls by about 49% on each policy, from 600K to 305K and from 575K to 291K, respectively (Appendix A.4 ). paragraphs.en: We presented LatentSift, a token-free and execution-free filter that scores candidate trajectories from the policy’s own reasoning, observation, and function-call states instead of replaying them through a second language model. Across three agents at K = 16 K=16 , LatentSift cuts EF-verifier tokens by 66.6–79.2% and total verification cost by 49.1–62.1% while raising or matching hybrid Best@16, and the savings carry over to a smaller policy and grow with the candidate budget. Policy-state filtering is therefore a drop-in replacement for the most token-consuming stage of hybrid verification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LatentSift，这是一种无需令牌且无需执行的过滤器，它基于策略自身的推理、观察和函数调用状态来评估候选轨迹，而不是通过第二个语言模型重新执行这些轨迹。 在 K = 16 的情况下，针对三种智能体，LatentSift 将 EF-verifier 的令牌数量减少了 66.6%–79.2%，总验证成本降低了 49.1%–62.1%，同时保持或提升了混合 Best@16 的性能；这种节省效果在较小的策略中同样存在，并会随着候选轨迹预算的增加而扩大。 因此，策略状态过滤是替代混合验证中最消耗令牌阶段的直接解决方案。

sents.zh: 在 K = 16 的情况下，针对三种智能体，LatentSift 将 EF-verifier 的令牌数量减少了 66.6%–79.2%，总验证成本降低了 49.1%–62.1%，同时保持或提升了混合 Best@16 的性能；这种节省效果在较小的策略中同样存在，并会随着候选轨迹预算的增加而扩大。

sents.en: Policy-state filtering is therefore a drop-in replacement for the most token-consuming stage of hybrid verification.
sents.zh: 因此，策略状态过滤是替代混合验证中最消耗令牌阶段的直接解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Token-free means that the filter adds no LLM input or output tokens, not that it requires no computation. At inference, the filter mean-pools states that the policy’s forward passes already produce, retrieves nearest neighbors from the two banks in each channel, and applies one linear head. Bank construction and scorer training are performed offline. A text verifier that rereads K K trajectories processes roughly K K times the average trajectory length in input tokens before prompt overhead, so the verification tokens of the original cascade grow linearly with K K (Figure 4 ). We count EF-verifier calls and test-generation calls separately, include only calls that are actually made, and exclude candidate generation. In the original cascade, Stage 4 reuses the Stage-1 EF scores and makes no new verifier calls (Appendix A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: “无令牌”意味着该过滤器不添加任何 LLM 输入或输出令牌，而非不需要计算。 在推理阶段，该过滤器对策略前向传播已生成的状态进行均值池化，从每个通道中的两个银行检索最近邻，并应用一个线性头。 银行构建和评分器训练均在离线状态下执行。 一个重读 K 条轨迹的文本验证器，在处理提示开销之前，其输入令牌数量约为平均轨迹长度的 K 倍，因此原始级联结构的验证令牌数会随 K 线性增长（图 4）。 我们分别统计 EF 验证器调用和测试生成调用的次数，仅计入实际执行的调用，并排除候选生成过程。 在原始级联结构中，阶段 4 会复用阶段 1 的 EF 分数，且不会进行任何新的验证器调用（附录 A.2）。

paragraphs.en: DeepSWE-Verifier and R2EGym-Verifier are the official verifiers of DeepSWE-Preview and R2E-Gym. They are LoRA adapters on Qwen3-14B and Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct, respectively. DEV matching-pairs is another Qwen3-14B LoRA adapter, trained on matched pairs of one successful and one unsuccessful rollout of the same task. All three adapters use rank 64 and α = 128 \alpha=128 ( Agentica, 2025 ; R2E-Gym, 2025b ; R2E-Edits, 2025 ) . The DeepSWE-Verifier and DEV matching-pairs model cards report a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , two training epochs, and cosine learning-rate decay with a warmup ratio of 0.05. AgentPRM ( Xi et al., 2026 ) was proposed for web agents such as web shopping and browser navigation. We port its official implementation to coding-agent trajectories and train it as a LoRA adapter with the same base model and configuration as DeepSWE-Verifier. CWM releases no verifier, so for CWM Agent we retrain the four baseline verifiers on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with their original recipes.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSWE-Verifier 和 R2EGym-Verifier 分别是 DeepSWE-Preview 和 R2E-Gym 的官方验证器。 它们分别是基于 Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct 的 LoRA 适配器。 DEV matching-pairs 是另一个基于 Qwen3-14B 的 LoRA 适配器，在相同任务的一次成功和一次失败执行结果的匹配对中训练而成。 这三种适配器均使用秩为 64 和 α = 128（Agentica, 2025；R2E-Gym, 2025b；R2E-Edits, 2025）。 DeepSWE-Verifier 和 DEV matching-pairs 的模型卡报告的学习率均为 10⁻⁵，训练轮次为 2，并采用余弦学习率衰减，其中预热比例为 0.05。 AgentPRM（Xi 等人，2026）是为网络智能体（如网络购物和浏览器导航）而提出的方法。 我们将该方法的官方实现移植到编码智能体的轨迹中，并以与 DeepSWE-Verifier 相同的基模型和配置将其训练为 LoRA 适配器。 CWM 未发布任何验证器，因此对于 CWM Agent，我们使用其原始配方在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上重新训练了四种基础验证器。

paragraphs.en: In the official hybrid workflow, the final stage ranks the candidates that pass the regression and generated tests by their stored Stage-1 EF scores and calls no separate verifier ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ) . Each EF baseline therefore uses its own checkpoint in Stages 1 and 4. LatentSift replaces Stage 1 and calls the policy-associated verifier only in Stage 4, namely DeepSWE-Verifier for DeepSWE-Preview, R2EGym-Verifier for both R2EGym policies, and the retrained DeepSWE-Verifier for CWM, whose workflow follows DeepSWE Agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在官方的混合工作流中，最终阶段会根据候选智能体在回归测试和生成测试中的表现，依据其存储的 Stage-1 EF 分数进行排序，并且不会调用任何独立的验证器（Luo et al., 2025；Jain et al., 2025）。 因此，每个 EF 基线模型都会在 Stage 1 和 Stage 4 中使用其自身的检查点。 LatentSift 会取代 Stage 1，并且仅在 Stage 4 调用与策略相关的验证器，即 DeepSWE-Preview 使用 DeepSWE-Verifier，R2EGym 的两种策略均使用 R2EGym-Verifier，而 CWM 则使用重新训练的 DeepSWE-Verifier，其工作流遵循 DeepSWE Agent。

paragraphs.en: EF-verifier tokens sum the input and output tokens of the verifier calls actually made rather than estimating them from a global mean length. An average EF call uses 22.9K tokens over the full R2EGym-32B candidate pool and 18.9K tokens over the candidates that reach the final verifier. The corresponding DeepSWE-Preview averages are 51.7K and 46.2K tokens. The original cascade scores all 16 candidates, whereas LatentSift calls the verifier only for the candidates that survive the execution stages, about four per task instance ( 76.0 ​ K / 18.9 ​ K ≈ 4.0 76.0\mathrm{K}/18.9\mathrm{K}\approx 4.0 on R2EGym-32B and 181.0 ​ K / 46.2 ​ K ≈ 3.9 181.0\mathrm{K}/46.2\mathrm{K}\approx 3.9 on DeepSWE-Preview, Table 1 ). Most of the saving therefore comes from making fewer EF calls, and a smaller part comes from the shorter average length of the surviving trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: EF-verifier 的 token 数量是实际执行的验证器调用中输入和输出 token 的总和，而不是根据全局平均长度估算得出的。 一次平均 EF 调用在整个 R2EGym-32B 候选池上会消耗 22.9K 个 token，在最终通过验证器的候选集上则会消耗 18.9K 个 token。 DeepSWE-Preview 的对应平均值分别为 51.7K 和 46.2K 个 token。 原始级联方法会对全部 16 个候选项进行评分，而 LatentSift 则仅对通过执行阶段的候选项调用验证器，每个任务实例大约只有四个候选项能通过（在 R2EGym-32B 上为 76.0K / 18.9K ≈ 4.0，在 DeepSWE-Preview 上为 181.0K / 46.2K ≈ 3.9，见表 1）。 因此，大部分节省源于减少了 EF 调用的次数，而较小的一部分则来自通过筛选的轨迹平均长度更短。

paragraphs.en: We generate Stage 3 tests once for each of the 500 task instances with R2E-TestgenAgent ( R2E-Gym, 2025a ) , the open-source test generator of the DeepSWE-Preview recipe, and run the same tests on the candidate patches of every configuration. A workflow is charged the test-generation cost only when it reaches Stage 3, at an average of 244.3K tokens per invocation according to the generation logs. paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 DeepSWE-Preview 配方中的开源测试生成器 R2E-TestgenAgent（R2E-Gym, 2025a），为每个任务实例中的 500 个实例各生成一次第 3 阶段的测试，并在每种配置候选补丁上运行相同的测试。 只有当工作流到达第 3 阶段时，才会产生测试生成成本；根据生成日志，每次调用的平均成本为 244.3K 个 token。 在 R2EGym-32B 上，原始级联流程中 95.5% 的任务实例达到了第 3 阶段，而我们的流程中这一比例为 93.7%。 因此，每个任务实例的总 token 数分别为：366.2K + 0.955 × 244.3K ≈ 600K（366.2\mathrm{K}+0.955\times 244.3\mathrm{K}\approx 600\mathrm{K}）和 76.0K + 0.937 × 244.3K ≈ 305K（76.0\mathrm{K}+0.937\times 244.3\mathrm{K}\approx 305\mathrm{K}），即表 1 和图 5 中提到的 49.1% 的节省量。 其他配置也遵循相同的计算方式，并使用各自第 3 阶段的达成率；例如，在 R2EGym-14B 上分别为 575.3K 和 291.2K 个 token（表 7）。
